entry.title: Efficient Transformer Inference on Edge Devices: A Systematic Evaluation
entry.summary: Deploying transformer models on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging. We evaluate quantization strategies. Code at https://github.com/example/edge-transformers.

entry.title: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Routing under Memory Constraints
entry.summary: We study expert routing for MoE models under strict memory budgets, evaluated on MMLU and GSM8K benchmarks with 50,000 samples.
